# Evanson DDS

> Dr. Angela Evanson's comprehensive family and cosmetic dental practice in Parker, Colorado offering advanced restorative and cosmetic services.

Evanson DDS is a full-service dental practice led by Dr. Angela Evanson, DDS, specializing in family dentistry, cosmetic treatments, and advanced restorative procedures including CEREC same-day crowns and dental implants. The practice serves the Parker, Colorado area with emergency dental care and specialized treatments for conditions like TMJ/TMD.

## Core Dental Services

- [Family Dentistry](https://evansondds.com/family-dentistry): Family dentistry services for children, teens, and adults in Parker, Colorado
- [General Treatment](https://evansondds.com/general-treatment): General dentistry services including crowns, implants, and whitening treatments
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://evansondds.com/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including veneers, whitening, and smile enhancement
- [Emergency Dentist](https://evansondds.com/emergency-dentist): Emergency dental care and urgent tooth pain treatment services

## Restorative & Replacement Services

- [Dental Implants](https://evansondds.com/dental-implants): Dental implant and tooth replacement services in Parker, Colorado
- [CEREC - Same Day Dentistry](https://evansondds.com/cerec-same-day-dentistry): CEREC same-day crown technology and dental restoration services
- [Dental Crowns](https://evansondds.com/dental-crowns): Dental crown restoration services including CEREC same-day crowns
- [Dentures](https://evansondds.com/dentures): Denture and dental prosthetics services for tooth replacement

## Cosmetic Enhancement Services

- [Teeth Whitening](https://evansondds.com/teeth-whitening): Professional teeth whitening and smile enhancement services
- [Veneers](https://evansondds.com/veneers): Porcelain veneer cosmetic dentistry services for smile makeovers

## Specialized & Pediatric Care

- [Early Dental Care](https://evansondds.com/early-dental-care): Pediatric and early dental care services for children and teething infants
- [Periodontics](https://evansondds.com/periodontics): Periodontal treatment and gum disease management services
- [Root Planing & Scaling](https://evansondds.com/root-planing-scaling): Root planing and scaling periodontal treatment for gum disease
- [TMJ/TMD](https://evansondds.com/tmjtmd): TMJ/TMD disorder treatment and jaw pain management services
